event_outbox_caldav_deleted_version_idx.name: event_outbox_caldav_deleted_version_idx
event_outbox_caldav_deleted_version_idx.where: "event_outbox"."status" = 'completed' and (("event_outbox"."action" = 'delete' and "event_outbox"."payload"->'caldavSeriesDeletion' is not null) or ("event_outbox"."action" = 'update' and ("event_outbox"."payload"->'caldavSeries'->'write'->'followingDelete' is not null or "event_outbox"."payload"->'caldavSplit' is not null)))

external_events_occurrence_series_check.name: external_events_occurrence_series_check
